num_time_periods: <int> Total number of equally spaced time periods spanning the planning day.
maximum_displacement_delta: <int> Maximum number of time periods by which any flight's scheduled departure may differ from its requested departure.
airports: <list[str], length num_airports> IATA codes of the airports in the network.

flights.dep_airport: <str> IATA code of the airport from which the flight departs.
flights.arr_airport: <str> IATA code of the airport at which the flight arrives.
flights.dep_period: <int> Requested departure time period for the flight.
flights.arr_period: <int> Requested arrival time period for the flight.
flights.delta_sch: <int> Scheduled en-route duration in time periods, equal to the difference between the requested arrival and departure periods.
flights.delta_min: <int> Minimum feasible en-route duration in time periods.
flights.delta_max: <int> Maximum feasible en-route duration in time periods.
flights.max_dep_delay: <int> Maximum allowable departure delay in time periods.
flights.max_arr_delay: <int> Maximum allowable arrival delay in time periods.
flights.cost_dep_delay: <float> Per-period cost of departure delay for this flight.
flights.cost_arr_delay: <float> Per-period cost of arrival delay for this flight.

aircraft_connections.flight_i: <int> Identifier of the first (arriving) flight in the aircraft turnaround connection.
aircraft_connections.flight_j: <int> Identifier of the second (departing) flight in the aircraft turnaround connection.
aircraft_connections.min_connection_time: <int> Minimum number of time periods required between the arrival of the first flight and the departure of the second flight.

passenger_connections.flight_i: <int> Identifier of the first (arriving) flight in the passenger itinerary connection.
passenger_connections.flight_j: <int> Identifier of the second (departing) flight in the passenger itinerary connection.
passenger_connections.min_connection_time: <int> Minimum number of time periods required between the arrival of the first flight and the departure of the second flight for passenger transfers.

VMC.a: <int> Coefficient on the number of departures in this capacity envelope segment under visual meteorological conditions.
VMC.b: <int> Coefficient on the number of arrivals in this capacity envelope segment under visual meteorological conditions.
VMC.Q: <int> Maximum combined weighted operations allowed per time period for this segment under visual meteorological conditions.

IMC.a: <int> Coefficient on the number of departures in this capacity envelope segment under instrument meteorological conditions.
IMC.b: <int> Coefficient on the number of arrivals in this capacity envelope segment under instrument meteorological conditions.
IMC.Q: <int> Maximum combined weighted operations allowed per time period for this segment under instrument meteorological conditions.

scenarios.id: <int> Unique identifier for the weather scenario.
scenarios.probability: <float> Probability that this weather scenario occurs.

operating_conditions.<airport_code>: <list[str], length num_time_periods> Weather condition (VMC or IMC) prevailing at this airport during each time period in this scenario.
